metadata.description: Agentes, skills e regra do stack desta casa.

plugins.name: tc96-core
plugins.description: Teste e contrato HTTP, e os papéis que atravessam qualquer stack. Habilite sempre.

plugins.name: tc96-frontend
plugins.description: React, TanStack Router e Query, React Hook Form e Storybook no stack desta casa — escrita, estrutura e revisão de interface. Habilite em projeto com frontend.

plugins.name: tc96-backend
plugins.description: Runtime Bun, Elysia e Drizzle — serviço HTTP, persistência e dependências. Habilite em projeto com backend.

plugins.name: tc96-tailwind
plugins.description: Tailwind CSS v4: setup, migration, build, variant split and review skills, each with its own normative docs (TW-*). Self-contained: enable alone or with tc96-frontend.

plugins.name: tc96-design-docs
plugins.description: Writing-only document skills: PRD, ADR, epic, feature, story, tasks, bug, spec and PR, each with its template and model tier. Self-contained: enable with tc96-core or alone.

plugins.name: tc96-e2e
plugins.description: Playwright — escrita, auditoria e diagnóstico de teste E2E. Habilite em projeto com suíte E2E.
